title: Prepare for the whole funnel, not just the coding round
takeaway: Each stage cuts people for a different reason, and the biggest cut, aptitude, is not where students spend their time.
sources: Students who spend all three months on DSA and none on aptitude regularly get filtered before anyone looks at their code.
This is where interviews are actually lost.
The HR round is not a formality.
They are the ones who prepared for the whole funnel instead of one part of it.

items.item: Clear the CGPA cutoff and backlogs
items.ifSkipped: Below the cutoff, most doors do not open regardless of skills

items.item: Aptitude, two to three hours a week
items.ifSkipped: Filtered before anyone looks at your code
Being unable to write a clean BFS is fatal

items.item: Core subjects: OS, DBMS, CN, OOP
items.ifSkipped: Unable to explain a deadlock in the technical interview

items.item: Two projects you can defend in depth
items.ifSkipped: Interviewers pick the one you understand least

items.item: Treat the HR round as a real round
